description: Instruction editing with Qwen-Image-2.1: re-renders a supplied picture toward a written instruction, the editing path the unified model advertises and models/qwen-image-2.1 does not exercise. Offload is a property of the mode, not the model: the condition image's latents are prepended to the noise, so an edit at 2048x1024 carries a longer sequence than plain text-to-image at 2048x2048, and under 'model' offload it runs out of memory by 582 MiB on a clean 24GB card - measured, and shape-determined rather than leakage from an earlier job - so this entry runs 'sequential' where the text-to-image entry runs 'model'. output_resolution is set to 2048 so the condition image is not resized down to the pipeline's 1024 default; width/height name the canvas the edit lands on. The VAE is tiled and sliced because the decode at this size does not otherwise fit, and the result is image/png because the pipeline returns RGBA. true_cfg_scale is left at its default of 1.0, so negative_prompt is ignored and the instruction has to be written positively. input_image takes a URL, a path, or an asset: reference - keep_output turns an earlier run's picture into one. width.reason: Qwen-Image-2.1 rounds width/height down to a multiple of 32 (vae_scale_factor * 2), so an off-grid value is not refused by the pipeline but silently shrunk - refused here instead, with no 'snap', since rounding the other way would be a second silent change to the size asked for
